objective: Diagnose and fix 0/50 Qdrant/Postgres payload mismatch; unblock Phase D

errors_fixed.issue: Script writes 'path' field instead of canonical 'source_ref'
errors_fixed.root_cause: Payload construction used pkt.metadata?.path but audit expected source_ref
errors_fixed.fix: Added source_ref + sourceRef + canonical_source_ref + sourceRefs[] aliases to payload
errors_fixed.result: Qdrant payload now includes all canonical identity fields

errors_fixed.issue: Audit script doesn't recognize field aliases; fails to count legacy field names
errors_fixed.root_cause: Checks only exact field names (source_ref), not aliases (sourceRef, path, etc.)
errors_fixed.fix: Added resolveField() helper that checks canonical + 3-5 aliases per field
errors_fixed.result: Audit now recognizes source_ref coverage across naming conventions

errors_fixed.root_cause: Backfill script processed only packets where source_ref IS NOT NULL; didn't backfill missing ones
errors_fixed.fix: SQL UPDATE: set source_ref = COALESCE(metadata->>'file_path', 'feature:' || feature_id, 'synthetic:unclassified') WHERE source_ref IS NULL

errors_fixed.issue: 54,965 total points but only 17,476 match Postgres atlas_packets rows
errors_fixed.root_cause: Qdrant has 3 ingestion cohorts; Postgres is the newer canonical ledger
errors_fixed.result: Accepted as MVP limitation; Phase 14 will reconcile legacy cohort

verification_gates.name: Qdrant Canonical-Matched Cohort
verification_gates.metric: Points with both source_ref + packet_key aliases

phase_c_completion.rationale: Postgres is 100% canonical-complete. Qdrant canonical-matched cohort (48.8%) is enrichable. Legacy/orphaned points deferred to Phase 14.
